manifest.about: Open-source RTL the flow was not written for, at fixed commits. nnc corpus fetches each into corpus/.cache (never committed) and runs the intake (and the adaptation) on every module of the folder, or on the listed tops. Only the verdicts are committed (corpus/results.json, docs/INPUT_SUPPORT.md).
